statement: Damron-Hanson Conjecture 1 asks for almost-sure absence of all bigeodesics for iid continuous nonnegative nearest-neighbor edge weights on Z^2, with no moment condition stated in the conjecture. A 2026-09-24 preprint claims the conclusion under the additional second-moment condition on the minimum of four weights; that proof is not certified here.
assumptions: Read Conjecture 1 in the paper's Z^2 nonnegative-edge-weight setup

source.quote: Suppose (t_e) is i.i.d. with continuous distribution. Almost surely there are no bigeodesics in dimension two.

proof_or_counterexample: Direct comparison with Theorem 1.1 on PDF page 1 of the dated 2026-09-24 public manuscript, which explicitly assumes E[min(X1,X2,X3,X4)^2]<infinity.
remaining_gap: Public proof and moment-free conjecture remain unverified; no mathematical proof supplied by this source row.

statement: Let marks on a horizontal grid k_j=(j l,0) have common marginal q. Let fixed deterministic additive Busemann functions B^alpha and B^(-beta) satisfy B^alpha(0,k_j)+B^(-beta)(0,k_j)=-wjl+o(jl) almost surely, w>0. If every consecutive pair of marked sites k_i<k_j satisfies b<=B^alpha(k_j,k_i)+B^(-beta)(k_j,k_i), then bq<=lw. Independence or ergodicity of marks is unnecessary.
assumptions: the pairwise comparison holds for successive marks
proof_or_counterexample: With A_j=B^alpha(0,k_j)+B^(-beta)(0,k_j), summing over m_N-1 consecutive mark pairs gives b(m_N-1)<=A_first-A_last<=wNl+2 max_(j<=N)|A_j+wjl|. The max error is o(Nl) from individual asymptotics. Since m_N/(Nl) is uniformly bounded and E m_N=(N+1)q, bounded reverse Fatou gives bq<=lw. Full derivation in ATTEMPT.md.
